metadata.title: Vendit Residuality
metadata.description: Unexpected business changes that could hit Vendit and its retailers, and the residues that keep the platform adaptable.
metadata.naiveArchitecture: A single-tenant Windows till with a cloud database, hand-built point integrations to each partner and one package-based licence model.
metadata.residualArchitecture: A channel-agnostic retail core (articles, prices, stock, sales) with an integration gateway shared with Katapull siblings, offline-capable clients, pluggable payments and structured documents, so new channels, devices and regulations become connectors rather than rewrites.

stressors.name: Katapull consolidates overlapping products
stressors.detection: Group roadmap announcements, shared sales teams, customers asking whether to move to Logic4.
stressors.attractor: Pressure to merge back ends or migrate chain customers to Logic4 while keeping small retailers on Vendit.
stressors.businessReaction: Define the Vendit-Logic4 boundary by segment, build coexistence through the integration gateway and offer a guided upgrade.
stressors.residue: Shared group integration gateway and data contracts for articles, stock and orders.

impacts.effect: Year-5 upgrade path inside the group.

stressors.name: Marketplaces capture most online demand in specialty categories
stressors.detection: Rising share of marketplace orders in Vendit tenants; webshop traffic flattening.
stressors.attractor: Retailers drop own webshops and depend on marketplace rules, fees and sync speed.
stressors.businessReaction: Make the marketplace module a default, tighten stock sync and expose seller-rating risk.
stressors.residue: Event-driven stock publication to any channel.

impacts.effect: Overselling rate becomes a top metric.

stressors.name: Tap-to-pay on phones replaces dedicated terminals
stressors.detection: Payment partners launch SoftPOS; retailers ask for mobile checkout.
stressors.attractor: Checkout moves to the shop floor on phones; hardware bundle revenue shrinks.
stressors.businessReaction: Abstract tenders behind the payment API and add a mobile checkout client.

stressors.name: Structured e-invoicing becomes mandatory for B2B
stressors.detection: EU and Dutch e-invoicing timelines; wholesale customers requesting Peppol or EDI invoices.
stressors.attractor: PDF invoices no longer accepted by business customers; suppliers send only structured invoices.
stressors.businessReaction: Route invoices and supplier documents through Transus and structured formats.
stressors.residue: Document exchange as a shared service with Transus.

stressors.name: Prolonged internet or cloud outage on a peak Saturday
stressors.detection: Monitoring alerts and helpdesk call spikes.
stressors.attractor: Stores cannot sell; trust in cloud POS drops.
stressors.businessReaction: Offline sales buffer on the workstation and later sync; clear outage communication.
